text:
Aisha: Quick kickoff for MedLedger POC evidence request — they want SOC 2 control narratives (redacted), ISO27001 cert excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation, and an SFTP upload path for artifacts. Can we cover all of this within 5 business days?
Tom: We usually provide a redacted SOC2 excerpt + control matrix. Pen-test attestation: we can provide vendor-signed letter. If they insist on a bespoke scan we bill extra. Who's handling signature?
Priya: Legal can sign the standard pen-test attestation template. I'll attach the template. Also confirm we do not share full SOC2 report, just the excerpt + bridge/summary.
Marco: Infra can provision ephemeral SFTP + presigned creds. Presigned link validity options: 7/14 days. If they need isolated dedicated staging for residency, that's a different charge — need estimate of token usage.
Aisha: Sales follow-up: customer explicitly asked for control narratives (not just checklist). Are those in our redacted package?
Priya: Yes — we have control narrative excerpts that we can send redacted. We'll pair with the SOC2 summary and the control mapping. Legal will review redaction.
sec-bot: automated note: evidence portal stub created at https://evidence.redwood.example/medledger-4258675309 — access expires in 7 days.
Tom: Can you upload the pen-test template, @Priya? Also I need a quick quote for dedicated POC capacity (onboarding + monthly) in case they push for single-tenant staging.
Priya: Uploading now: `docs/attestations/pen_test_attestation_template.pdf` — legal will sign and return scanned copy.
Marco: Landing plan: I'll provision SFTP creds after we have the contact email. Default creds TTL 14d. If they want IP allowlist, send me the CIDR block list.
Aisha: Pricing note for sales: if they request dedicated reserved capacity for data residency, ballpark onboarding $6k and monthly $4k for a small GPU pool. @Tom please confirm final numbers.
Tom: Noted — I'll confirm with pricing ops and update the quote by EOD.
Priya: Also need NDA signer name and entity for the attestation paperwork. Ask customer to confirm.
Aisha: Action items: (1) @Marco — provision SFTP after DM w/ contact, (2) @Priya — prepare redacted SOC2 excerpt + sign pen-test attestation, (3) @Tom — update dedicated POC quote and confirm billing impact. Customer timeline: wants artifacts in 5 business days.
Marco: Got it, I'll stand by.
Priya: On it — will post when the signed attestation and SOC excerpt are ready.
Tom: I'll ping pricing and loop back.
Aisha: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
